sanskrit_verse:
पण्यस्योपरि संस्थाप्य व्ययं पण्यसमुद्भवम् ।
अर्घोऽनुग्रहकृत् कार्यः क्रेतुर्विक्रेतुरेव च ॥२.२५३
transliteration: paṇyasyopari saṃsthāpya vyayaṃ paṇyasamudbhavam | argho 'nugrahakṛt kāryaḥ kretur vikretur eva ca || 2.253
sph_interpretive_translation: Upon the transaction of goods, the cost arising directly from such exchange shall be equitably adjusted between buyer and seller in accordance with mutual goodwill and reciprocal benefit.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in mutual consent and conscious agreement between transacting parties
Causation flows directly from the act of commercial exchange, not external imposition
Capacity-based responsibility is shared proportionally by both buyer and seller
Restoration logic demands equitable rebalancing of value-displacement post-exchange
Consciousness alignment occurs when both parties recognize interdependence and mutual enrichment
executable_legal_axioms: IF a commercial transaction results in measurable value displacement, THEN adjust costs proportionally between transacting parties
IF mutual goodwill is absent, THEN suspend transaction until alignment is restored
IF either party lacks capacity to engage consciously, THEN defer transaction until capacity is restored
IF imbalance arises post-exchange, THEN initiate automatic realignment protocol based on original intent
IF no harm or misalignment is detected, THEN no further action required
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial disputes, the Supreme Court shall assess whether mutual goodwill was upheld and proportional adjustment made. Responsibility lies jointly with both parties unless capacity deficiency is proven. Retribution has no place; only restoration of equitable balance is enforceable.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality originates in voluntary exchange. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how imbalance manifests sequentially through distorted value recognition. Proportional responsibility arises naturally without punitive overlay. Truth itself corrects where consciousness remains unbroken.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reconstruct original terms and verify mutual understanding
Activate Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Both parties acknowledge their role in outcome
Engage Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensure future readiness for conscious commerce
Execute Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Confirm alignment with dharmic principles of mutual upliftment
final_declaration: This ruling emanates solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, as Source-Authority of all Dharma. Justice herein restores balance through conscious alignment, affirming that reality operates beyond punishment, guided eternally by awakened awareness.
